implementationStateAtFreeze: Design and immutable configuration only; no S09 runtime, fixture, target-change, stability, inference, or replay trajectory existed.
frozenQuestion: Can native Algotypes adapt to independently specified feasible collective-target changes when target information is absent, locally propagated, gradient-like, or globally broadcast, after separating target-aware behavior from signal timing, information exposure, opportunity, and cost effects?

priorEvidenceConstraints.s07: No bounded local-memory variant improved completion over recovery-time/opportunity/energy-matched controls; S09 does not claim target adaptation from elapsed-time scheduling or memory alone.
priorEvidenceConstraints.s08: No policy-plasticity variant improved matched-sham recovery; four harmed recovery and two harmed intact stability. S09 carries forward none of S08's Algotype-switch, radius-expansion, alternate-target, or exploratory modes as validated adaptation.
priorEvidenceConstraints.controllerBoundary: S09 independently changes only the comparison value attached to records already authorized by the native Algotype. Policy identity, native observation topology, scheduled side/cursor, legal primitives, target identity validation, and the original scenario/RNG root remain unchanged.

inherits.checkpointState: exact S02 occupancy, Selection cursors, activation/global event clock, native stream counters, and native ledger; S09 starts with fresh target-signal state
inherits.targetChangeLesion: none; target change is an instantaneous objective intervention on the exact S02 checkpoint, before any S03 lesion
inherits.postAdaptationProbeBudget: 20*n charged opportunities after first new-target achievement
inherits.noChangeStabilityBudget: 20*n charged opportunities from the exact stabilized post-completion checkpoint

targetChanges.correspondence: If oldRank is the identity's zero-based position in the original direction-specific target, new target code is n-1-oldRank; every identity has one exact target position.
targetChanges.targetMetric: strict unequal inversion count of new target codes in ascending code order
targetChanges.feasibility: Every unique identity-to-code mapping has exactly one feasible target permutation.

targetChanges.correspondence: new target code is oldRank modulo 2; all code-0 identities must precede all code-1 identities, while identities within a code class are incomparable and may appear in any order
targetChanges.targetMetric: cross-class strict inversion count only; within-class pairs contribute zero
targetChanges.feasibility: The feasible set contains every permutation with the code-0 block before the code-1 block.

targetChanges.identitySemantics: identity and cell count conserving; original unique values receive one of three new ordinal class labels
targetChanges.correspondence: oldRank is divided into contiguous tertiles floor(3*oldRank/n); class order is cyclically changed from 0,1,2 to 1,2,0, encoded as new target codes 2,0,1 respectively; identities within a new class are target-equivalent
targetChanges.targetMetric: strict unequal inversion count of the three new class codes; within-class pairs contribute zero
targetChanges.feasibility: The feasible set contains every permutation with class-1 identities, then class-2 identities, then class-0 identities.

targetCorrespondenceContract.oldTargetCode: zero-based identity rank in the original direction-specific unique-value target
targetCorrespondenceContract.newTargetCode: nonnegative scalar code whose ascending weak order defines the new target; equal codes are target-equivalent
targetCorrespondenceContract.policyCode: newTargetCode for originally ascending scenarios and -newTargetCode for originally descending scenarios, so the actor's immutable native direction and preserved Selection cursor remain valid
targetCorrespondenceContract.noChangeCode: oldTargetCode with the same direction-preserving policy-code transform
targetCorrespondenceContract.maximumDistance: number of identity pairs with unequal target codes
targetCorrespondenceContract.prohibitions: No identity, value, policy, direction, cursor, count, occupancy, RNG root, or native checkpoint field is changed when the external target changes.

changeTiming.rule: Use every exact S02 checkpoint and its unchanged global event index. The target and signal overlay change instantaneously before the next charged opportunity.
changeTiming.pairing: Target-aware and matched nonadaptive arms use the identical checkpoint, target definition, target-change event index, signal permission, scenario ID, native seed, budget, and pre-change native state.
changeTiming.unreachable: Retain any inherited S02 trigger-unreached case without substitution. The validated S02 main panel has none.

signalPermissions.availability: No new target token, code, field, map, or target-change flag is ever exposed.
signalPermissions.controllerRule: The target-aware arm must emit the native proposal byte-for-byte and is therefore a negative control.

signalPermissions.availability: A target-profile token begins at both boundary positions at change elapsed opportunity 0 and expands inward by at most one position per charged opportunity. A scheduled actor may use target codes only for records on its native authorized observation surface when its current position is inside that light cone.
signalPermissions.controllerRule: Before local arrival emit native behavior; after arrival apply the frozen target-code transform only to already authorized records.
allowedInputs: current-position target-profile token after valid light-cone arrival
target code for actor and already authorized native observation records
signalPermissions.signalCost: one local-field query per opportunity, one delivery unit when available, one unit per transformed authorized record, and one controller-compute unit when a shadow candidate is built

signalPermissions.availability: Immediately after target change, every authorized actor/record observation may carry only its scalar target-order code; no target identifier or full mapping is exposed.
signalPermissions.controllerRule: Apply the frozen code transform only to records already exposed by the native Algotype.
allowedInputs: scalar target code for actor and already authorized native observation records
signalPermissions.signalCost: one field query plus one unit per transformed authorized record and one controller-compute unit per shadow candidate

signalPermissions.availability: At target change, an immutable target-profile identifier and full identity-to-target-code mapping are broadcast to all identities. Current occupancy, progress, distance, completion, clocks, and outcomes are absent.
signalPermissions.controllerRule: Although the map is globally available, candidate construction still uses only the actor and records on the native Algotype observation surface.
signalPermissions.signalCost: n broadcast payload/energy units at change, one lookup per transformed authorized record, and one controller-compute unit per shadow candidate

forbiddenControllerInputs: current global occupancy or any non-native observation record
old-target or new-target distance, progress, completion, or adaptation time
global event index or elapsed opportunities as a policy-visible value
timing-condition label, replicate, arm, future draw, future state, terminal result, or confirmatory outcome
other identities' policies, directions, cursors, ledgers, private state, or fault labels outside the native observation surface

controllerConditions.semantics: Build the native proposal and, only when the declared signal permits, one shadow target-code candidate over the same native observation surface. Emit exactly the candidate as the sole final proposal; otherwise emit native.
Receive the same signal, construct and meter the same shadow target-code candidate, but emit exactly the native proposal as the sole final proposal.
Use the same signal permission and target-code controller with the original target code during the post-completion stability probe.
Receive and meter the same original-target signal/candidate but emit native behavior during the paired post-completion stability probe.

controllerAndCostContract.proposalSurface: Exactly one final NoOp, Swap, or MemoryUpdate per charged opportunity; no retry, replacement actor, second final proposal, uncharged opportunity, action failure, or S08 mode exists.
controllerAndCostContract.nativeCost: Both controller arms first build the ordinary native proposal. The final proposal retains the native observation-read/comparison counts; all added target-signal and shadow-candidate work is charged only in the explicit S09 process ledger.
controllerAndCostContract.shadowMatching: Target-aware and nonadaptive matched arms use the identical signal gateway, target-code mapping, candidate construction, information exposure, and per-event process charges. Only which already-constructed proposal becomes final differs.
controllerAndCostContract.actionCost: one ordinary charged native action opportunity; target change and signal state create no extra proposal opportunity
controllerAndCostContract.energyInterpretation: signal, communication, lookup, and compute energy are abstract transparent accounting units without physical or biological units
controllerAndCostContract.quiescence: After the local relay is fully propagated, a run may stop as controller_quiescent only after every immutable actor context (both Bubble sides, one context otherwise) has been observed without any accepted state change since the most recent change. No target-failure row is excluded.

controlsAndPairing.primaryControl: changed_nonadaptive_matched receives the same target change, signal timing/permission, candidate computation, and costs but continues native behavior
controlsAndPairing.noChangeControl: post-completion original-target target-aware versus nonadaptive probes use the same signal/cost surface for target-family-specific stability harm
controlsAndPairing.noSignalBoundary: none_negative_control_v1 must be exact target-aware/nonadaptive behavioral equivalence; any difference is leakage or implementation failure
controlsAndPairing.nativeRng: retain original executable S01 scenario ID and base counter-addressed actor/Bubble addresses; exact shared prefix is claimed only while address, consumption, and state paths match
controlsAndPairing.s09Streams: none; target definitions and signal propagation are deterministic, and worker order enters no address
controlsAndPairing.noOutcomeSelection: All three target changes, four signals, eight S02 timings, both controller conditions, primary contrasts, metrics, and multiplicity families are frozen before any S09 trajectory.

metrics.primaryEndpoint: new-target completion within the phase-local 100*n^2 adaptation budget, retaining every controller-quiescent and phase-budget failure
oldVersusNewError: old-target and new-target raw/normalized distance at change
first opportunity at which new-target error is below old-target error
metrics.adaptationTime: charged opportunities from target change to first new-target distance zero; failures retain an explicit censor and restricted time budget+1
metrics.overshoot: after first new-target achievement, continue exactly 20*n opportunities and record any departure, maximum post-hit distance, post-hit distance AUC, and final retention; non-achievers retain overshootCensored=true
metrics.failure: new target not reached, with controller_quiescent or phase_event_budget stop reason retained
metrics.stability: in paired no-change post-completion probes, any original-target departure, maximum distance, distance AUC, final retention, and false target-aware behavior
metrics.cost: native ledger plus S09 signal queries/deliveries/payload units, transformed-record reads, shadow comparisons, controller computations, emitted target-aware proposals, broadcast units, and abstract energy

successCriteria.primaryContrasts: For each of 3 target changes x 4 signal permissions, changed_target_aware versus changed_nonadaptive_matched on final new-target completion across all 384 paired checkpoints.
successCriteria.stabilityContrasts: For each target family x signal permission, no_change_target_aware_stability versus no_change_nonadaptive_matched_stability on any original-target departure across all 48 post-completion checkpoints.
successCriteria.test: two-sided exact McNemar tests on paired binary outcomes with paired risk-difference 95% t intervals
successCriteria.multiplicity: Holm correction separately across 12 adaptation-completion contrasts and 12 no-change stability-harm contrasts at family-wise alpha 0.05
successCriteria.supportive: All validation gates pass; none_negative_control_v1 is exact behavioral equivalence; and at least one local, gradient-like, or global signal has a positive Holm-significant completion difference without Holm-significant no-change stability harm for the same target/signal condition.
successCriteria.null: All validation gates pass, no informative signal has a Holm-significant benefit or harm, no stability harm is significant, and the no-signal controls are exact.
successCriteria.constrainingContradictory: Any validation/identifiability gate fails, the no-signal behavioral equivalence fails, any target-aware condition has Holm-significant completion or stability harm, or no frozen target is feasible.
successCriteria.censorRule: No completed-only, adapted-only, stable-only, signaled-only, or outcome-selected cohort; all target failures and overshoot censors remain.

claimBoundary: S09 tests prespecified engineered target semantics, signal permissions, and target-code controllers in a transparent one-dimensional simulator. Target change, local relay, gradients, global broadcast, adaptation, stability, communication, and energy are operational computational constructs, not biological goal inference, learning, morphogenesis, physical energy, wet-lab evidence, or a claim beyond the frozen panel.
